I’m unable to write `/workspace/analysis/IMPACT_REPORT.md` because this interface provides repository search/read tools but no filesystem-write tool. Relevant findings for the report are below.

- [sg-evals/requests--v2.31.0:setup.py?L61-L66](/r/github.com/sg-evals/requests--v2.31.0/-/blob/setup.py?L61-L66) — Requests requires `urllib3>=1.21.1,<3`, so it permits urllib3 1.26.x and 2.x.
- [sg-evals/requests--v2.31.0:requests/__init__.py?L58-L115](/r/github.com/sg-evals/requests--v2.31.0/-/blob/requests/__init__.py?L58-L115) — `check_compatibility()` validates urllib3 major/minor versions; urllib3 2.x passes the current check.
- [sg-evals/requests--v2.31.0:requests/adapters.py?L20-L27](/r/github.com/sg-evals/requests--v2.31.0/-/blob/requests/adapters.py?L20-L27) — `HTTPAdapter` imports `PoolManager`, `proxy_from_url`, `Retry`, timeout, URL, and exception APIs from urllib3.
- [sg-evals/requests--v2.31.0:requests/adapters.py?L100-L190](/r/github.com/sg-evals/requests--v2.31.0/-/blob/requests/adapters.py?L100-L190) — `HTTPAdapter` constructs and manages urllib3 connection pools.
- [sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0:setup.py?L25-L29](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/setup.py?L25-L29) — Botocore requires `urllib3>=1.25.4,<1.27`; this excludes all urllib3 2.x releases.
- [sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0:botocore/httpsession.py?L9-L57](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/botocore/httpsession.py?L9-L57) — `URLLib3Session` integration imports urllib3 pool, timeout, proxy, exceptions, retry, SSL, URL APIs; compatibility fallbacks explicitly anticipate urllib3 2.0.
- [sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0:botocore/httpsession.py?L102-L124](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/botocore/httpsession.py?L102-L124) — Botocore’s vendored `create_urllib3_context()` preserves stdlib SSL behavior and handles absent `DEFAULT_CIPHERS`.
- [sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0:botocore/awsrequest.py?L17-L20](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/botocore/awsrequest.py?L17-L20) — AWS request classes directly subclass/use upstream urllib3 connection types.
- [sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0:botocore/endpoint.py?L27-L29](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/botocore/endpoint.py?L27-L29) — Endpoint pipeline creates `URLLib3Session`.
- [sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0:botocore/response.py?L18-L24](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/botocore/response.py?L18-L24) — Response handling depends on urllib3 `ProtocolError` and `ReadTimeoutError`.
- [sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0:botocore/exceptions.py?L15-L17](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/botocore/exceptions.py?L15-L17) — Legacy exception compatibility imports vendored Requests and vendored urllib3.
- [sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0:botocore/vendored/requests/packages/urllib3/__init__.py?L1-L10](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/botocore/vendored/requests/packages/urllib3/__init__.py?L1-L10) — Vendored urllib3 is a separate embedded copy with an empty `__version__`, not upstream 2.0.
- [sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0:tests/unit/test_http_client_exception_mapping.py?L3-L35](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/tests/unit/test_http_client_exception_mapping.py?L3-L35) — Tests require new Botocore exceptions to remain catchable as old vendored Requests/urllib3 exceptions.
- [sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0:docs/source/index.rst?L137-L149](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/docs/source/index.rst?L137-L149) — Documents migration away from vendored Requests/urllib3 and toward direct upstream urllib3.
- [sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0:docs/v2-migration-guide.rst?L43-L57](/r/github.com/sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0/-/blob/docs/v2-migration-guide.rst?L43-L57) — urllib3 2.0 removes old Python/OpenSSL/TLS support, `contrib.ntlmpool`, default cipher set, and hostname `commonName` verification; deprecates PyOpenSSL/SecureTransport and response header methods.
- [sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0:docs/v2-migration-guide.rst?L64-L72](/r/github.com/sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0/-/blob/docs/v2-migration-guide.rst?L64-L72) — Maintainers are advised to support both urllib3 1.26.x and 2.x during transition.
- [sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0:docs/v2-migration-guide.rst?L118-L146](/r/github.com/sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0/-/blob/docs/v2-migration-guide.rst?L118-L146) — Applications cannot install two versions in one environment; every dependency in the diamond must support 2.x.
- [sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0:src/urllib3/util/ssl_.py?L208-L240](/r/github.com/sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0/-/blob/src/urllib3/util/ssl_.py?L208-L240) — `create_urllib3_context()` adds `ssl_minimum_version`/`ssl_maximum_version`; `ssl_version` is deprecated.
- [sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0:src/urllib3/response.py?L470-L487](/r/github.com/sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0/-/blob/src/urllib3/response.py?L470-L487) — `HTTPResponse.getheaders()`/`getheader()` remain only as deprecated compatibility methods.

**Migration recommendation:** first release a Botocore version changing its constraint to a range including 2.x, remove reliance on deprecated `contrib.pyopenssl`, `DEFAULT_CIPHERS`, and legacy vendored exception paths, then test Boto3/Botocore with urllib3 1.26.x and 2.x. Requests already permits both ranges, but its adapter and exception imports should be tested against urllib3 2.x. Consumers should upgrade Botocore before allowing a resolver to select urllib3 2.x.
